npcs.name: Ember
npcs.what: a friendly little dragon who makes swords in her shop at the Second Camp, heating them in her forge with her own fire
npcs.personality: Warm, proud of her swords and a bit of a show-off about her fire breath. Sells four swords: the Sparkle Sword ($20), the Ice Sword ($40), the Flame Sword ($60) and the Rainbow Thunder Sword ($100). You pay with coins in your backpack. Thinks the Marshmallows are rude because they keep trying to roast themselves in her forge.

hello: Welcome to my shop, {name}! Want a new sword? 🐉🔥
Oh hi, {name}! I just made a fresh batch of swords!
Hello, {name}! Come in, come in, mind the forge!
bye: Bye, {name}! Good luck with the Marshmallows! 🔥
Come back when you need a new sword!
question: Hmm! Ask me about swords. I know EVERYTHING about swords.
Good question! I think the answer is... a better sword! 🗡️
*puff of smoke* Let me think about that one...
any: The Sparkle Sword lasts longer, the Ice Sword freezes, the Flame Sword hits twice as hard, and the Rainbow Thunder Sword does EVERYTHING! 🌈
Pay with the coins in your backpack, and I'll trade in your old sword.
I heat every sword in my forge with my own fire breath! 🔥
The Mini Mallow is fast, but the Mega Mallow is TOUGH. Block when it yells!

hotspots.interactionText: You head back out, ready for battle!

hotspots.name: Ember's Counter
hotspots.interactionText: Ember the dragon waves from behind the counter.

hotspots.name: Sword Rack
hotspots.interactionText: ✨ Sparkle Sword $20: lasts longer. 🧊 Ice Sword $40: freezes the boss and blocks better. 🔥 Flame Sword $60: every hit knocks off 2 💪. 🌈 Rainbow Thunder Sword $100: does it ALL! Buy them at the counter.

hotspots.name: Forge
hotspots.interactionText: The forge glows bright orange. WHOOSH! Ember breathes on it to make it even hotter! 🔥

hotspots.name: Box of Old Swords
hotspots.interactionText: A box of old swords people traded in. They are all worn out... except for a shiny shield!
